explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1168: a ZFC proof of ℵ_{ω+1} ↛ (ℵ_{ω+1}, 3, 3, …)²_{ℵ₀}. CardinalCountableColorRamsey κ says every ℕ-colouring of pairs of κ has either a colour-0 homogeneous set of size κ or a monochromatic triangle in some positive colour, which is exactly the arrow relation. Its negation is the desired negative relation. Diagonal elements of Sym2 are never consulted. It is correctly marked open, since only the GCH case is known.
